title: RHRS Law Firm
description:
RHRS Law Firm suffered a data breach in which we leaked all client files - court cases, client personal information, and so on.
The company claims to care about customer privacy and data, but after our numerous reports about the leak to the email of the chief lawyer, the company blatantly ignores the incident - they do not care about their customers, they do not care about this incident.
